purpose: Resolve the V1R2 patch-count evidence-contract defect by auditing the immutable sealed outputs under the actual per-window physical tunnel-layer semantics, without regenerating geometry.

approval.scope: One read-only corrective evidence audit of the sealed C09 V1R2 run. Verify 71 windows, the actual 65 two-layer + 3 three-layer + 3 one-layer distribution, 142 physical window-layers, 426 three-resolution patches, 15833 frame rows and the 506-entry source seal. Zero geometry generation, LiDAR, inference, graph replay, training, C10 or M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: After the V1R2 count defect was reported, the user established the persistent objective '针对我们完整的需求跑下去' and instructed continued end-to-end progress.

raw_sources: Immutable sealed C09 geometry V1R2 result directory and its 506-entry SHA-256 manifest.
excluded_sources: V1R interrupted partial assets, C10, M-TARE, model outputs, graph outputs and checkpoints.

sampling.rule: Read the existing 15833-row audit exactly once; no resampling, deletion or geometry recomputation.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher; this audit distinguishes directed incident support arcs from unique physical tunnel layers.
teacher.valid_mask: Every existing frame row must pass all three resolutions, and every physical window-layer must have exactly one patch at each resolution.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No planner or model is run. Audit PASS only restores eligibility to prepare the separately governed frozen C09 causal replay.

split.historical_pollution_audit: No model selection or parameter calibration occurs; this operation only audits sealed C09 validation evidence.

evidence.machine_metrics: 71 windows; physical-layer distribution 1:3, 2:65, 3:3; 142 layers; 426 patches; 2054 arc endpoints; 15833 frames; 506 source seal entries.
evidence.complete_visual_review: No new preview is required because all ten sealed V1R2 complete figures are hash-verified rather than regenerated.
evidence.failure_policy: Any seal/hash/cardinality/integrity/frame mismatch is FAIL. V1R2 remains immutable FAILED regardless of audit outcome.
